rules.name: gold_label_consistency
rules.requirement: Popup presence, blocking, message text, observability, scenario and source-observation labels satisfy the v1 conditional contract.

rules.name: no_action_and_pre_action_source
rules.requirement: action_attempts is empty, decision is no_action or abstain, and prediction uses only an action-free observation.

rules.name: evidence_and_adjudication
rules.requirement: Gold and prediction evidence are resolvable; formal validation/test labels receive independent annotation and adjudication before release.

rules.name: metric_recomputation
rules.requirement: presence_correct, critical-information recall and VPMA are recomputed from atomic labels, predictions and adjudicated semantic values.

rules.name: task_specific_eligibility
rules.requirement: Synthetic and paper-reconstruction items cannot enter v1 empirical metrics; v1 cannot enter advanced recovery or user-experience claims.

rules.name: release_and_leakage_controls
rules.requirement: Group leakage, permissions, privacy, artifact disposition and release checks reuse the union dataset gates and must pass before publication.
